BiblicalUsage: tsammereth is the word for fleeciness, i.e. foliage. It appears 5 times in Scripture, including Ezekiel 17:3 and Ezekiel 31:3.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tsammereth because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
